mix_ratio.label: Mixing ratio
mix_ratio.text: 4.3 - 4.4 Litres of clean cool water per 20 kgs of powder

recoat_times.label: Waiting time to overcoating
recoat_times.text: Allow 6 - 7 hours at 23°C prior to installing moisture sensitive flooring

recoat_times.label: Waiting time to overcoating
recoat_times.text: Allow 5 - 6 hours at 23°C prior to installing tiles or stone

recoat_times.label: Waiting time to overcoating
recoat_times.text: The undiluted applied Sikafloor® 01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU)must dry for 2 hours minimum before tiling begins.

compat.text: This special high polymer formulation and embedded fibres provide reinforcement suitable for wood, timber or CFC type subfloors.
compat.heading: DESCRIPTION

compat.text: ▪ Recommended underlayment for all Commercial & Domestic floor coverings ▪ Suitable to be applied over semi-flexible substrates such as soundly fixed/adhered timber, chip board, plywood or CFC sheet ▪ Suitable to be applied with underfloor heating systems ▪ Levelling of new or old concrete substrates ▪ Levelling over soundly adhered tiles, stone or vinyl ▪ Interior applications
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Sikafloor®-4020 FiberLevel is a special Hybrid binder based leveling compound which is not compatible with other cements.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Not recommended as a trafficable surface.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use on sloped surfaces that require drainage.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: If water penetrates, then a good bond with Sikafloor® 01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® Level Pro Primer can be achieved
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY / PRE-TREATMENT

compat.text: This is to be followed by a thorough clean prior to installing a neat coat of Sikafloor® 01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU) & Sikafloor®-4020 Fiber- Level.
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY / PRE-TREATMENT

compat.text: Porous Priming (concrete) > Sikafloor® 01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU) – Mix ratio diluted 1:2 or 1:3 with clean water. > Sikafloor® Level Pro Primer - undiluted ( Neat ) Note: Correct amount of priming liquid should always be applied to the prepared substrate giving good penetration and film build
compat.heading: PRIMING

compat.text: Semi-flexible (timber, wood, CFC, scyon) > Sikafloor® 01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU) – undiluted (Neat) Note: When applying primer to Timber/wood/CFC & Scyon use a paint roller and apply one even coat
compat.heading: PRIMING

compat.text: Sikafloor® 01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU) (Neat) Must Be Completely Dry (90-120min) prior to applying Sikafloor®-4020 FiberLevel.
compat.heading: PRIMING

compat.text: Closed off rooms with no fresh air will retard the curing/drying process and possibly lead to product failure. 3. compat.heading: APPLICATION

precautionary_statements.statement: If medical advice is needed, have product container or label at hand.
precautionary_statements.text: P101 If medical advice is needed, have product container or label at hand.

precautionary_statements.statement: Keep out of reach of children.
precautionary_statements.text: P102 Keep out of reach of children.

precautionary_statements.statement: Read carefully and follow all instructions.
precautionary_statements.text: P103 Read carefully and follow all instructions.
P264 Wash skin thoroughly after handling.

precautionary_statements.statement: Wear protective gloves/ eye protection/ face protection.
precautionary_statements.text: P280 Wear protective gloves/ eye protection/ face protection.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.
precautionary_statements.text: P302 + P352 IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. Immediately call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.
precautionary_statements.text: P305 + P351 + P338 + P310 IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. Immediately call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.

precautionary_statements.statement: If skin irritation occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.
precautionary_statements.text: P332 + P313 If skin irritation occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.

precautionary_statements.statement: Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.
precautionary_statements.text: P362 + P364 Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

storage.label: Further information on storage stability
storage.text: Keep in a dry place. No decomposition if stored and applied as directed.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Avoid dust formation. Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation at places where dust is formed.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator. particulate filter P

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber, PVC, cotton gloves

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Avoid dust formation. Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation at places where dust is formed.
